Static capacity excludes graph/workspace/metadata/runtime overhead. Prior zero-residency is historical, not current. A future pass is loader/tokenizer feasibility only; no generation, natural competence or model superiority follows.

remaining_requirements: Root must approve the exact immutable frozen protocol hash before the one attempt.

limitations: Polling and overlapping cgroup components do not create hard per-process memory isolation or an exact capacity bound.

Review is bounded code/protocol assurance, not a formal proof or an executed model-quality result.
